name: The Unmet
title: the Unmet
role: Satiated Sovereign of Span — the thin one. She took distance entire, and nothing that reaches for her arrives

diminished.note: ⚑ R41, and thin: she reached satiation a generation ago and her hold is incomplete. Arriving means being somewhere — the one thing she refused — and it costs her almost everything.

final.note: ⛔ thin even at the last. The lore's 'beatable in the 30–60 band, if the pipeline is found before it sets.' This is the Sovereign a campaign can finish.

wants: To never again be close enough to be left.
Distance, everywhere — every road a little longer, every letter a little later, every person a little further from the next.
fears: ⚠️ Arrival. Being somewhere, next to someone, with nowhere further to go.
appearance: Always at the far end of the road. Up close — and almost nobody has been — a young horizon-walker, travel-worn, with eyes that focus past you as if you were already a long way off.
voiceHints: She speaks as if calling across a valley: clear, a little too loud, and never waiting for the answer to arrive.
_authoredWhy: SNG-643, Erik 2026-09-24: 'yes' to a thin seat; 'Span is meant to be distance.' A horizon-walker who could not bear to arrive, and kept going until nothing could reach her. Recent — a generation — and so thin. Her supply line is the Switchback Tollmen: a toll that makes the near far. Her starvation is every crossing kept open to anyone: the Echo Bridge, the Keelmouth slip, the Bridgewright.
